questions.title: Do 32 unsigned service-desk vouchers 'in lieu of compensation' offset the compensation owed?
questions.found: 32 passengers hold service-desk vouchers 'in lieu of compensation' with no signed acceptance. CRM records the voucher as accepted; there is no signature hash.
questions.why_flagged: Art. 7(3) needs signed acceptance for an offset, and the sources disagree. No precedent for unsigned in-lieu vouchers.
questions.recommends: No signed acceptance, no offset: pay cash; the voucher stays as goodwill.
questions.recommended_option: Pay €250 cash; the voucher stays as goodwill
options: Pay €250 cash; the voucher stays as goodwill
Offset the voucher: pay the balance in cash
Ask the passenger to sign the acceptance first
